live_proof: CVE-2026-2003, fixed upstream in 3d160401b65e, which postdates the 17.5 pin. On the pin the cast is accepted where a correct build rejects it: the purecap run errors on 0 of the 2 statements upstream refuses
fidelity: real server, core. The out-of-bounds read stays inside the palloc block, so no sanitizer and no capability machine sees it; the accepted input is the evidence. On the host the same case printed about forty words of adjacent heap, and on the purecap arm the value came back empty -- the arms show different amounts of the same defect, which is recorded rather than averaged
